svg.title: Тяга в тренажёре с односторонней нагрузкой — положение 1
svg.desc: Original ImageGen hollow contour, vector traced. One-arm seated independent-lever row with unilateral load. The athlete sits facing a horizontal plate-loaded machine with a vertical chest pad. Machine has two clearly separate rigid lever arms and pivots with weight pegs. One circular plate on working side ONLY; nonworking side shows a visibly empty plate peg. Same arm nearest viewer grasps working-side handle in BOTH views, other hand remains relaxed on thigh. LEFT working arm reaches forward, right hand side unchanged. RIGHT the same working hand comes back to lower ribs and elbow points behind torso. Idle handle stays at rest. Feet remain planted and chest remains on pad. No cables, no dumbbells. Expert biomechanics approval pending.
